component.name: Plasma Shortcut Explorer
component.summary: Search your configured KDE global shortcuts

description.p: Explore the keyboard shortcuts registered with KDE Plasma. Search actions, applications, categories, and key combinations using a native keyboard-first window.
Plasma Shortcut Explorer reads your current configuration without changing bindings. It requires a running KDE Plasma 6 session and its KGlobalAccel service.

Adopt native KDE window controls, shortcut columns, and scrollable settings. Focus search with the slash key or Ctrl+F and refresh with Ctrl+R. Keep the window open when focus moves to another application.
Add launcher search keywords, a resizable overlay with adaptive columns, compact selection details, and clearer shortcut counts.
Bound shortcut discovery and improve test isolation and uninstall safety.
Initial shortcut discovery and searchable overlay.
